map.家庭自测注意什么？: What should I watch for in home testing?
map.家庭自测：由收缩压/舒张压判级别，识别高血压: Home testing: classify by the systolic/diastolic pressure and identify hypertension
map.脉压 = 收缩压 − 舒张压: Pulse pressure = systolic pressure - diastolic pressure
map.脉压>60mmHg 常见于动脉硬化、主动脉瓣关闭不全等；老年人脉压增大多与血管弹: A pulse pressure >60 mmHg is common in atherosclerosis and aortic regurgitation; a widened pulse pressure in older people is mostly related to declining vascular elasticity and should be assessed in the overall picture.
map.脉压大说明什么？: What does a wide pulse pressure indicate?
map.脉压观察：脉压过大提示动脉硬化等，供就诊时参考: Pulse pressure watch: an overly wide pulse pressure suggests atherosclerosis and similar changes, for reference when you see a doctor
map.血压分级工具。输入收缩压/舒张压，按标准（正常<120/80、1 级 140–1: Blood pressure grading tool. Enter systolic/diastolic pressure and grade the blood pressure and pulse pressure by the standards (normal <120/80, grade 1 140-159/90-99, etc.). For self-screening only; the doctor diagnosis prevails.
map.静坐休息 5 分钟、坐姿背部有支撑、袖带与心脏同高，非同日三次升高才更有意义；单: Rest sitting quietly for 5 minutes, support the back, keep the cuff at heart level; three elevated readings on separate days are more meaningful, and a single high reading is nothing to panic about.
map.风险分层：结合分级决定生活方式或就医: Risk stratification: combine with the grade to decide on lifestyle changes or seeking care

Example 2 (158/96): pulse pressure 62 mmHg -> level 4 (grade 2 hypertension), medical attention advised.
